response.original_title: 青春禁忌游戏之灵魂交换
response.overview: Beneath the seemingly peaceful atmosphere of a university campus lurks a mysterious figure harboring an astonishing secret. When Shi Hao and Lin Xiao accidentally enter an ancient building on campus, they trigger a forbidden game that causes their souls to switch bodies. As the game begins, their once-familiar surroundings take on an unsettling new reality. Classrooms are no longer as peaceful as they seem, and ordinary campus life gradually transforms into something strange and unpredictable.
